# Playcue / 플레이큐

> A cue list of local audio files for a show or a class. When a track ends it STOPS.
> The next cue only starts when the operator taps the giant GO button.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://playcue.try-dabble.com/
Cue names and order stay in this browser; the audio files themselves are copied into
the Origin Private File System on this device. No accounts, no uploads, no server storage.

This is NOT a music player. It does NOT auto-advance to the next track like MusicPlay
or notevibes. There is no shuffle, no crossfade, no streaming, no YouTube, no device
library crawl and no TV remote.

## Pages

- [Home](https://playcue.try-dabble.com/): Cue list, now-playing readout, giant GO button
- [Privacy](https://playcue.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://playcue.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/playcue): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add local audio files (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg) with the file picker, several at once
- Reorder cues up and down, remove a cue, clear the whole list
- Cue list shows current / next / how many remain
- Now-playing name in the largest type on the page
- Play and pause the CURRENT cue only
- End of track: stop, arm the GO button, do not start the next track
- Giant GO button sized for a thumb at 390px
- Optional loop-one, off by default
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
